To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the generator and bubble configuration of a DAR system is of great importance and can influence the COP by a factor of 3.
the second and the third configurations have a higher COP compared to the first configuration and that the second configuration has a higher COP compared with the third configuration.
The first configuration resulted the lowest performance, the second configuration resulted in the highest COP and the third configuration resulted in the second highest COP.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the generator configuration on the performance.
the influence of the generator configuration on the performance and COP of the DAR system.
the influence of the generator on the performance of the DAR system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the second configuration is the best configuration in terms of desorbing the highest amount of the refrigerant from the rich solution and the third configuration is the best in terms of COP.
the second configuration is the most efficient in terms of desorption, and the third configuration is the most effective in terms of heat input.
the third configuration has the best performance in terms of COP, but the second configuration has the best COP in terms of refrigerant desorbed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the second configuration is the most efficient configuration in terms of refrigerant desorption and COP.
in order to improve the performance of DAR systems the heat must be supplied directly to the poor solution and the heat transfer between rich and poor solution must be minimized.
a configuration in which the rich solution is heated directly and the poor solution is not heated is the best in terms of COP and the highest amount of desorbed refrigerant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a DAR cycle can be designed to have a high COP by utilizing minimum heat as possible, and desorbing as much refrigerant from the solution as possible.
a generator and bubble pump with a configuration of heat input into the solution with no heat input to the annular, is the best choice for a DAR system.
the configuration of the bubble pump and generator is of great importance for a DAR system.
